annotations.message: Mimir {{ $labels.pod }} in {{ $labels.cluster }}/{{ $labels.namespace }} is running a very high number of Go threads.

expressions.A:
{"model":{"datasource":{"type":"prometheus","uid":"mimir"},"expr":"# We filter by the namespace because go_threads can be very high cardinality in a large organization.
max by(cluster, namespace, pod) (go_threads{job=~".*(cortex|mimir).*"} > 8000)

# Further filter on namespaces actually running Mimir.
and on (cluster, namespace) (count by (cluster, namespace) (cortex_build_info))","instant":false,"intervalMs":60000,"maxDataPoints":43200,"range":true,"refId":"A"},"datasource_uid":"mimir","query_type":"","relative_time_range":{"from":"10m0s","to":"0s"}}
